ex.en: She won a bronze medal in the swimming final yesterday.
ex.zh: 她在昨天的游泳决赛中获得一枚铜牌。

words.note: bronze 指青铜；铜牌是 bronze medal，金牌是 gold。

ex.en: He had no clear conception of how much work the project required.
ex.zh: 他对这个项目需要多少工作没有清晰的认识。

words.note: conception 指观念、构想；concept 更常指具体概念。

ex.en: The municipal government plans to build a new park downtown.
ex.zh: 市政府计划在市中心建一座新公园。

words.note: municipal 指市的、市政的，来自拉丁语“城市”。

ex.en: The police detained two men for questioning after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故发生后，警方拘留两名男子问话。

words.note: detain 指拘留或耽搁；be detained by traffic 表被堵。

ex.en: He works at a research institute that studies climate change.
ex.zh: 他在一家研究气候变化的机构工作。

words.note: institute 作名词指研究所，作动词指设立、开始实行。

ex.en: The family endured great hardship during the war years.
ex.zh: 这家人在战争年代忍受了巨大苦难。

words.note: endure 指忍耐，也指持久；形容词 enduring 表持久的。

ex.en: The report explains in detail how the new system will work.
ex.zh: 报告详细说明了新系统将如何运作。

words.note: in detail 是固定搭配；details 复数指具体细节。

ex.en: Skateboarding began as a youth subculture in American cities.
ex.zh: 滑板最初是美国城市里的一种青年亚文化。

words.note: sub- 表“次、亚”，subculture 指某群体的独特文化。

ex.en: Please wear clothes that are appropriate for a formal interview.
ex.zh: 请穿适合正式面试的衣服。

words.note: appropriate 后接 for/to，反义词 inappropriate。

ex.en: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a laptop.
ex.zh: 价格不是选择笔记本电脑的唯一标准。

words.note: criterion 复数是 criteria，单数常被误用。

ex.en: In essence, the two plans aim at the same goal.
ex.zh: 本质上，这两个计划目标相同。

words.note: essential 是形容词；in essence 表“本质上”。

ex.en: He likes to pore over old maps in the library.
ex.zh: 他喜欢在图书馆里专心研读旧地图。

words.note: pore over 表专心阅读，不要与 pour 混淆。

ex.en: The new tool has little practical utility for most users.
ex.zh: 这个新工具对多数用户没什么实用价值。

words.note: utility 指效用，也指水电等公用事业。

ex.en: Read the user manual before you turn on the machine.
ex.zh: 开机前请先阅读用户手册。

words.note: manual 作形容词指手工的，作名词指手册。

ex.en: The driver had to maneuver carefully to park in the narrow space.
ex.zh: 司机必须小心操作，才能把车停进狭窄的车位。

words.note: maneuver 是美式拼写，英式作 manoeuvre。

ex.en: The city orchestra will perform a famous symphony next Saturday evening.
ex.zh: 市交响乐团下周六晚将演奏一部著名交响曲。

words.note: symphony 指交响曲；symphony orchestra 是交响乐团。

ex.en: Her eloquent speech moved many people in the hall to tears.
ex.zh: 她雄辩的演讲让礼堂里许多人感动落泪。

words.note: eloquent 指口才好、有说服力；名词 eloquence。

ex.en: Experts are optimistic about the country's economic growth this year.
ex.zh: 专家对该国今年的经济增长持乐观态度。

words.note: optimistic 接 about；反义词 pessimistic 表悲观的。

ex.en: The bridge has a dual role as a road and a railway.
ex.zh: 这座桥兼作公路和铁路，具有双重作用。

words.note: dual 指双重的；duel 指决斗，拼写相近易混。

ex.en: The submarine stayed under water for several weeks without surfacing.
ex.zh: 这艘潜艇在水下待了几周没有浮出水面。

words.note: sub- 表“下”，marine 表“海”，故 submarine 指潜水艇。

ex.en: Technology affects almost every aspect of our daily life.
ex.zh: 技术几乎影响我们日常生活的每个方面。

words.note: aspect 指某个方面，常用 an aspect of sth。

ex.en: The company adopted an aggressive sales strategy to win new customers.
ex.zh: 公司采取了激进的销售策略来争取新客户。

words.note: aggressive 可指好斗的，也可指有进取心的。

ex.en: The last question on the exam completely stumped me.
ex.zh: 考试最后一道题把我彻底难住了。

words.note: stump 作动词表难住，作名词指树桩、残根。

ex.en: Teachers praised the students for their good behavior during the trip.
ex.zh: 老师表扬了学生们在旅行中的良好表现。

words.note: behavior 美式拼写，英式作 behaviour。

ex.en: The international federation sets the rules for all member clubs.
ex.zh: 国际联合会为所有成员俱乐部制定规则。

words.note: federation 指联合会或联邦；动词 federate 表结成联邦。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet can minimize the risk of head injury.
ex.zh: 戴头盔能把头部受伤的风险降到最低。

words.note: minimize 指减到最低；反义词 maximize 表最大化。

ex.en: The plane began to descend through thick clouds towards the airport.
ex.zh: 飞机开始穿过厚厚的云层向机场下降。

words.note: descend from 可指从…下来，也可指血统源自。

ex.en: Nodding your head can signify agreement in many cultures.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，点头可以表示同意。

words.note: signify 指表示、意味着；名词 sign 表标志。

ex.en: From these facts, the only logical conclusion is that he lied.
ex.zh: 从这些事实看，唯一合乎逻辑的结论是他撒了谎。

words.note: logical 指合乎逻辑的；logic 是名词，表逻辑。

ex.en: The two brothers finally reached a reconciliation after years of silence.
ex.zh: 沉默多年后，两兄弟终于和解。

words.note: reconcile 是动词；reconciliation 指和解、调和。
